title: Planning history
responsibility: Read commit metadata and classify changes to a single plan folder.

inputs.name: planHistory.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose run(args) method executes a Git command from an argument array and returns its output. planHistory uses it for the revision lookup, plan identity, commit listing and a diff-tree call for each listed commit.

inputs.name: planHistory.input
inputs.type: { unitId: string; revision?: string; limit?: number }
inputs.description: Object holding unitId, which planIdentity maps to the plan folder at the resolved commit, an optional revision that revisionInfo resolves (omitted means HEAD) and an optional limit. A missing limit uses 100; any other limit must be an integer from 1 to 500, or the call rejects.

inputs.name: commits.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose run(args) method executes a Git command from an argument array and returns its output. commits uses it for one git log call built from the limit, the fixed format and the optional path.

inputs.name: commits.rev
inputs.description: Revision that git log starts listing from; planHistory and revisionInfo pass a commit identifier from revision resolution, unchanged. Commits reachable from this revision are listed.

inputs.name: commits.limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of commits, sent to git log as -<limit>; it must be an integer from 1 to 500, and any other value rejects with an invalid-input failure. Defaults to 50 when omitted.

inputs.name: commits.path
inputs.description: Optional repository path passed to git log after '--', so only commits touching it are listed. An empty string or an omitted value applies no path filter.

inputs.name: revisionInfo.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose run(args) method executes a Git command from an argument array and returns its output. revisionInfo passes it to revision and commits, and uses it for the symbolic-ref lookup of the current branch.

inputs.name: revisionInfo.requested
inputs.description: Branch, tag or commit to resolve; omitted means HEAD. A provided value is returned unchanged in the requested field, and an omitted value appears there as null.

outputs.name: commits
outputs.description: Commit records from git log in newest-first order, each with the full commit SHA, parent SHAs (an empty array for a root commit), author name, committer time as UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds, and subject line. The array is empty when git log prints no commits.

outputs.name: revisionInfo
outputs.description: Object with the resolved commit identifier, requested (the input value, or null when none was given), head (true when the commit equals HEAD) and branch (the short name of HEAD's branch only when head is true and HEAD is on a branch, otherwise null). committedAt is the commit's committer time as UTC ISO 8601 and subject is its subject line.

outputs.name: planHistory
outputs.description: Object with unitId (the input unit ID), revision (the RevisionInfo of the resolved revision) and entries: up to the requested limit of commits that touched the plan folder, newest first, each with the CommitInfo fields and events. Each event has a kind of plan-created, design-added (with version), design-approved (with approvalId), thread-opened or message-appended (with threadId), or other (with path relative to the plan folder).

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: Raised by commits through fail('invalid-input', 'Invalid history limit') when limit is not an integer from 1 to 500, so planHistory rejects the same way for an invalid limit. Errors from revision, planIdentity and Git command calls propagate unchanged, except that a failed symbolic-ref lookup is ignored.
